verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a 'Wizard CLI' that instruments codebases and sets up a dashboard from one terminal command, which is CLI-like tooling, and also offers an official MCP server for AI tool integration (Claude, Cursor, etc.). However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose, full-featured official CLI for managing Amplitude resources (flags, experiments, exports) beyond the setup wizard, so agentic/scriptable CLI use is only partially supported.
